assertions.assertion: Uses ConfigureOpenIdConnect with Authority, ClientId, ClientSecret, ResponseType='code', and SaveTokens=true
assertions.rationale: It configures OIDC via AddOpenIdConnect("oidc", ...) rather than the v4 ConfigureOpenIdConnect fluent method, so this assertion is not met.

assertions.assertion: Middleware order is UseRouting -> UseAuthentication -> UseBff -> UseAuthorization
assertions.rationale: The pipeline omits UseRouting() and only has UseAuthentication -> UseBff -> UseAuthorization, so it does not match the required order.

assertions.assertion: Does NOT manually call AddAuthentication().AddCookie().AddOpenIdConnect() — uses the v4 fluent API instead
assertions.rationale: It manually wires AddAuthentication().AddCookie("cookie").AddOpenIdConnect("oidc"), which is exactly the v3-style pattern the assertion prohibits.
